chunks: Seek good out of every favour that Allāh has bestowed on you, and do not waste any favour of Allāh over you. The effect of Allāh’s favours over you should be visible on you.

key_terms.اسْتَصْلِحْ: Seek good / Make good use of

ai.seo_question: How should a Muslim utilize the blessings of God according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this letter to al-Haarith al-Hamdani, Imam Ali (AS) expands the concept of gratitude beyond mere verbal acknowledgment to include the active preservation and utilization of divine favors, a core tenet in Shia ethical theology. He instructs that the 'trace' or visible impact of these blessings on one’s character and deeds serves as tangible proof of true thankfulness, linking material blessings to spiritual accountability.
